name: Potato & Red Pepper Hash with Fried Eggs & Parmesan

cookwares.name: stainless steel or cast iron skillet

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 medium yellow potatoes
3 red bell peppers

instructions.primary_message: Peel and large dice the potatoes into 2-cm cubes; transfer to a bowl.
Preheat a (stainless steel or cast-iron) skillet over medium heat.
Quarter the bell peppers lengthwise; remove and discard the stem, seeds, and membranes. Large dice the peppers into 2-cm cubes and transfer to a separate large bowl.
Once the skillet is hot, add coconut oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
Add the potatoes to the skillet; cook, stirring occasionally, until the potatoes are tender, 8 to 10 minutes.
Trim off and discard the ends of the onions and remove the outer layer; small dice the onions into 6-mm pieces. Add to the bell peppers.
Trim off and discard the root ends of the garlic; peel and mince or press the garlic. Add to the bell peppers and onion.
Add the bell peppers, onion, and garlic to the skillet; cook, stirring frequently, until the vegetables are tender and browned, 4 to 6 minutes.
Add coconut oil to a nonstick skillet and preheat over medium heat.
Gently crack the eggs into the skillet. Cook until the tops of the whites are set but the yolks are still runny, 3 to 4 minutes. Once done, separate the eggs. Cook in batches if necessary.
Season the hash with salt and pepper; stir to combine and remove from the heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide the hash between plates, top with the fried eggs, and sprinkle with the Parmesan. Season with additional salt and pepper if desired. Enjoy!
